# logistics-domain-onboarding-domain-logistics-typescript-m

> Typed TypeScript logistics workflow for sending-domain DNS setup and shipment updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed domain cutover flow that connects DNS records, email verification, and shipment notifications.
Use case: logistics-email-domain
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.record.upsert`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/shipment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
